week.name: Friday
week.short: Patchy Fog then Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: Patchy fog before 11am, then a chance of rain. Mostly cloudy. High near 46, with temperatures falling to around 44 in the afternoon. South wind 1 to 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%.

week.name: Saturday
week.detailed: Rain and snow likely before 8am, then rain and snow likely between 8am and 5pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 44. West wind 2 to 8 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%.
